title: Beneath the Neon
style: Dark cyberpunk meets classical British noir

scenes.description: London is engulfed in alien firefights. Clara, a tech-savvy journalist, watches the chaos from a rooftop as glowing alien ships descend.
scenes.camera: Drone shot sweeping across ruined streets, transitioning to a handheld close-up of Clara's terrified face
scenes.lighting: Harsh neon reflections against smoke-filled skies, with flashes from energy weapons
scenes.dialogue: This isn't a war... it's a search!
scenes.video_prompt: Post-apocalyptic London skyline under crimson alien lights, shattered glass everywhere, Clara's POV camera shaking with panic, glowing symbols etched into alien armor

scenes.description: Clara escapes through collapsing tunnels, discovering a fallen alien soldier with a glowing symbol on its chest.
scenes.camera: Dynamic tracking shot following Clara through debris, switching to a low-angle close-up of the symbol
scenes.lighting: Dim emergency lights casting long shadows, with the symbol emitting a pulsating blue glow
scenes.video_prompt: Clara dodging falling rubble in a dark tunnel, close-up of the glowing symbol on the alien's chest, glowing circuit patterns spreading across the walls

scenes.description: Clara deciphers the symbol in a hidden library, finding ancient blueprints of London's underground infrastructure.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot of the library, transitioning to a spinning 360-degree view of the blueprints
scenes.lighting: Warm amber light from old lamps contrasting with the blueprints' electric blue ink
scenes.dialogue: They're looking for the Heart... the city's ancient core.
scenes.video_prompt: Dusty library with holographic blueprints floating in mid-air, Clara's fingers tracing glowing lines, dust motes sparkling in the light

scenes.description: Clara reaches the subterranean chamber, revealing alien tech intertwined with London's forgotten history.
scenes.camera: Slow dolly shot revealing the chamber's scale, switching to a vertigo-inducing spinning shot
scenes.lighting: Cold bioluminescent light highlighting ancient mechanisms and alien machinery
scenes.video_prompt: Vast underground chamber with glowing gears and crystalline structures, London's history etched into the walls, light reflecting off metallic surfaces

scenes.description: The aliens reveal they're searching for the city's lost energy core - a dormant ancient artifact buried beneath London.
scenes.camera: Two-shot of Clara and the alien leader, transitioning to a wide shot of the awakening artifact
scenes.lighting: Golden light erupting from the core, illuminating both characters
scenes.dialogue: We seek balance, not conquest. The core must awaken.
scenes.video_prompt: Alien leader with glowing eyes communicates with Clara, energy core pulsating at center frame, light rays connecting the characters
